profile_evidence.profile_audit: the prospective manifest binds the independent candidate-build-profile-audit-v1.json supplement and candidate-build-parity-v3.json receipt; this is required because the retained baseline build receipt predates profile environment fields
profile_evidence.profile_name: release is required as a non-empty string; missing profile fields never compare equal
profile_evidence.profile_overrides: raw profile_overrides metadata is retained for review only and must not be treated as effective unless the standalone benchmark environment records it

required.argv: exact release cargo build argv containing --locked --offline --release and the perf harness manifest
required.rustc_vv: exact compiler fingerprint; must equal retained baseline
required.source_receipt: descriptor object for the exact candidate-source-final.json

capture_status: schema documentation only; no candidate child was run
purpose: Exact candidate custody contract consumed by comparison-capture-v2.py before a prospective 48-child freeze.

runner_inputs.capture_approval: LITCHI_PERF_0923_CAPTURE_APPROVED=1 is required only after root readiness review

forbidden_substitutions: candidate_patch supplied only by an environment fallback
a fabricated candidate commit or source_head

required.cargo_lock: descriptor object for the candidate quality/workspace Cargo.lock; SHA must equal baseline
required.harness_patch: descriptor object for the exact shared harness patch; SHA must equal baseline harness patch
required.probe_lock: descriptor object for the perf harness Cargo.lock; SHA must equal baseline
required.production_patch: descriptor object for the exact reviewed candidate.patch
required.source_archive: descriptor object {path,bytes,sha256} for the actual candidate source archive
required.source_files: non-empty list of relative candidate changed-file paths; every path must occur in source_listing
required.source_listing: descriptor object {path,bytes,sha256} for external JSONL full source closure
required.source_tree: object {path} naming extracted candidate source tree; file hashes come from source_listing, not a directory SHA-256

source_listing_record.closure_rule: the listed relative files and hashes must equal every regular file under source_tree
